plugins.name: legal-clinic
plugins.description: Sets up the clinic, onboards students, runs structured intake, tracks deadlines with malpractice-aware caution, and hands off cases at semester end — built within ABA Formal Op. 512.

skills.name: build-guide
skills.description: Help a clinic supervisor author a practice-area guide that configures how student-facing skills behave — intake questions, pedagogy posture (assist / guide / teach), review gates, cross-plugin checks, and local rules. Use when a supervising attorney wants to build or revise a per-practice-area guide, tune how the clinic skills behave for their clinic type, or set their teaching philosophy as plugin configuration.
headings: Key things your guide should address
skills.description_zh: 帮助法律诊所导师编写修订分执业领域指南，配置学生技能的接案问题、协助指导教学立场、评审关卡、跨插件检查及本地规则。

skills.name: client-comms-log
skills.description: Log a client communication — call, email, text, letter, in-person, voicemail. Append-only per-case record with dated entries, direction, medium, summary, action items. Works alongside /client-letter and /status client. Use when logging a call or client email, reviewing a communication log, or asking "what did we tell [client] last time".
headings: What this skill does not do
skills.description_zh: 以案件为单位追加记录电话、邮件、短信、信件、当面或语音留言，包含日期、方向、媒介、摘要与行动项，支持回顾此前沟通。

skills.name: client-intake
skills.description: Structured intake — practice-area templates, cross-area issue spotting, conflict flags, and triage classification. Produces a formatted case summary the student analyzes and the professor reviews. Does NOT decide case acceptance. Use when starting a new client intake, running an intake interview, or writing up a new client's situation.
skills.description_zh: 依据执业领域模板进行结构化客户接案访谈，识别跨领域问题、冲突标记及初筛类别，生成供学生分析和教授评审的案件摘要，不决定是否接受案件。

skills.name: client-letter
skills.description: Routine client correspondence from templates — appointment confirmations, document requests, brief "we filed it" updates. Plain language, required elements, supervision routing. NOT substantive advice. Use when a student needs to send routine correspondence, an appointment confirmation, a document request letter, or a brief status note to a client.
headings: What this skill does NOT do
skills.description_zh: 按模板撰写预约确认、材料请求和简短提交进度等日常客户通信，使用简明语言、必要要素及监督流转，不提供实质法律意见。

skills.name: cold-start-interview
skills.description: Professor's one-time clinic setup — practice areas, jurisdiction, supervision style (formal review queue / configurable flags / lighter-touch), and handbook/rules upload. Writes CLAUDE.md so every other skill and every student who runs /ramp reads from the same clinic context. Use on fresh install, when CLAUDE.md has placeholders, when re-doing setup with --redo, or when re-checking integrations with --check-integrations.
headings: Check for the shared company profile
After the user picks quick or full
Quick start or full setup — branching
Part 0: Who's running this setup, ethical preconditions, and what's connected (before anything else)
Part 3: Supervision style (2-3 min — this is the key design question)
skills.description_zh: 为教授一次性配置法律诊所领域、司法辖区、监督方式和手册规则，写入共享CLAUDE.md，支持首次、占位、重设及集成复查。

skills.name: customize
skills.description: Guided customization of your legal clinic profile — change one thing without re-running the whole cold-start interview. Adjust clinic profile, jurisdiction, supervision style, practice-area templates, semester configuration, or output safeguards. Use when the user says "change my [thing]", "new semester", "add a practice area", "update my config", or "customize".
skills.description_zh: 单项调整法律诊所画像、司法辖区、监督方式、领域模板、学期配置及输出保护，无需重做入门访谈。

skills.name: deadlines
skills.description: Track case deadlines — add, cross-case rollup report, update, complete, close. Warns at configurable thresholds (default 14/7/3/1 days); overdue items stay flagged until resolved. The operational record for a clinic workload. Use when a student or supervisor needs to add a deadline, ask what's due this week, get a deadline report, or update a case deadline.
skills.description_zh: 跟踪案件期限的添加、跨案汇总、更新、完成及关闭，默认在14/7/3/1天提醒，逾期持续标记直至解决，支持每周到期查询。

skills.name: draft
skills.description: First draft of a common clinic document — practice-area templates (asylum applications, eviction answers, protective order petitions, demand letters), jurisdiction-aware formatting, explicitly a starting point requiring student analysis and attorney review. Use when a student needs a first draft of a motion, letter, petition, declaration, or other clinic document.
headings: What this draft does NOT do
What this skill does NOT do
skills.description_zh: 按执业领域模板及司法辖区格式生成动议、申请、声明或函件初稿，明确只是需学生分析和律师评审的起点。

skills.name: form-generation
skills.description: Reference: DEPRECATED — use `/draft` instead. This skill has been folded into the draft skill, which handles practice-area document generation including form population. Kept as a redirect for migration.
skills.description_zh: 原说明已弃用：表单生成和填充合并到draft，本条仅保留迁移重定向。

skills.name: memo
skills.description: IRAC-scaffolded case analysis memo with research gaps flagged — the scaffold, not the analysis. Rule blocks are RESEARCH NEEDED, Application is STUDENT ANALYSIS prompts, Conclusion is blank. Use when a student needs to scaffold a case analysis memo, write up their analysis, or build an IRAC memo for a case.
headings: Step 3: Identify strengths, weaknesses, open questions
skills.description_zh: 建立IRAC案件分析备忘录框架，标记待研究规则、提供学生适用分析提示并留空结论，不代写法律分析。

skills.name: plain-language-letters
skills.description: Reference: DEPRECATED — use `/client-letter` for routine correspondence or `/status client` for substantive updates. Split into two more focused skills during the v2 rebuild. Kept as a redirect for migration.
skills.description_zh: 原说明已弃用：日常通信转client-letter，实质进度更新转status client，本条仅保留迁移重定向。

skills.name: ramp
skills.description: Student semester onboarding — clinic procedures, tool walkthrough, practice exercises before real cases. Reads the handbook the professor uploaded at setup and teaches it interactively. Use when a new clinic student says "onboard me", "I'm new to the clinic", "getting started", or at the start of each semester; pass --card for the one-page reference.
headings: What this skill does NOT do
skills.description_zh: 为新学期学生讲解法律诊所程序、工具与实案前练习，读取教授上传手册并互动教学，可生成单页参考卡。

skills.name: research-start
skills.description: Research roadmap for a legal issue — statutes to check, case law areas to investigate, regulatory frameworks, Westlaw search terms. Leads and frameworks, NOT authoritative citations; students verify and develop everything. Use when a student asks where to start researching, wants a research roadmap for an issue, or needs gaps identified in existing research.
skills.description_zh: 为法律问题提供需查法条、判例领域、监管框架及Westlaw检索词的研究路线，标出已有研究缺口；提供线索而非权威引用，须学生核验深化。

skills.name: semester-handoff
skills.description: End-of-semester case handoff memos — the mirror of /ramp. Produces per-case transition memos and a cohort summary so the departing cohort hands work to the incoming cohort cleanly. Reads deadlines, client-comms, and case history. Use when the professor or departing students need to wrap up the semester, build transition memos, or offboard a graduating/withdrawing student.
skills.description_zh: 依据案件期限、客户沟通及历史生成学期末逐案交接备忘录和班级汇总，支持新旧学生工作衔接及毕业退出。

skills.name: status
skills.description: Case status summary by audience — client-facing (plain language), internal (for the professor), or court-ready (formal caption format per local rules). Same facts, different framing and depth. Use when a student needs to update the client, brief the professor, or prepare a court status report.
headings: What this skill does NOT do
Close with the next-steps decision tree
skills.description_zh: 根据受众生成法律诊所案件状态摘要，支持面向客户的简明语言、教授内部简报或符合本地规则的正式法院报告，同一事实采用不同深度表达。

skills.name: supervisor-review-queue
skills.description: Professor's review queue — student output waits here for professor approval before going to clients or courts. Only active if "formal review queue" supervision style was chosen at setup; otherwise dormant. Use when the professor wants to see what's waiting for review, approve, edit-then-approve, or return an item.
headings: What this skill does NOT do
skills.description_zh: 在设置选择正式评审队列时，将学生成果置于教授审核队列，批准后才供客户或法院使用，支持查看、批准、修改后批准和退回；其他监督方式下不启用。
